Container.Name: SuperSync
Container.Overview:
SuperSync is the self-hostable sync backend for Super Productivity (https://super-productivity.com), letting you sync your tasks/notes across devices without relying on Dropbox/WebDAV or the hosted service.
Upstream (super-productivity/super-productivity) only publishes this image to a **private** GHCR registry (see https://github.com/super-productivity/super-productivity/issues/6225), so this is an unofficial public rebuild of the same, unmodified source (packages/super-sync-server), pushed daily to Docker Hub.
REQUIRES A SEPARATE POSTGRESQL 16 DATABASE — this template does not bundle one. Install a Postgres container first (e.g. from Community Applications), create a database/user for SuperSync, then point the "Database URL" variable below at it.
There are no upstream release tags — this image tracks the `master` branch and has no stability guarantee. Pin to a specific `latest`-alternative sha tag (see the Docker Hub tags list) rather than `latest` for anything you care about staying stable.
No Terms of Service / privacy policy is baked in; see the PRIVACY_* variables in upstream's env.example if you need one generated for your deployment.
Container.Requires: A separate PostgreSQL 16 (or compatible) database, reachable from this container, is required before starting.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port the server listens on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent app data directory.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Postgres 16 connection string for a database you create/manage separately, e.g. postgresql://supersync:PASSWORD@POSTGRES_IP:5432/supersync?connection_limit=60&pool_timeout=10 (the connection_limit param is important, see Overview).

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Secret used to sign auth tokens, minimum 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: URL your users/devices use to reach this server, with protocol. Used in verification/magic-link emails. MUST start with https:// unless you also set Node Env below to something other than production.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to call this server (add your self-hosted frontend URL if applicable).

Config.Name: WebAuthn RP ID
Config.Description: Relying-party ID for passkey login: your domain, without protocol or port. Changing later invalidates existing passkeys.

Config.Name: WebAuthn Origin
Config.Description: Where users reach the auth UI, with protocol. Normally the same as Public URL.

Config.Name: Node Env
Config.Description: Set to something other than 'production' to allow http:// Public URLs (e.g. for LAN-only/testing use).

Config.Name: Run Migrations On Startup
Config.Description: Run Prisma database migrations automatically each time the container starts. Disable once your schema is stable if you'd rather run migrations manually.

Config.Name: Allowed Emails
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of exact addresses and/or *@domain rules restricting who may register. Leave blank to allow anyone who can reach the server.

Config.Name: Default Storage Quota (Bytes)
Config.Description: Per-user storage quota in bytes applied to accounts created from now on (default 104857600 = 100MB). Existing accounts keep the quota they were created with; raising this does NOT widen anyone's existing quota. To change an existing user's quota, run: UPDATE users SET storage_quota_bytes = <bytes> WHERE email = '<email>'; against your Postgres database.

Config.Name: Sync Upload Rate Limit (max)
Config.Description: Max POST /api/sync/ops requests per minute, enforced per user AND per source IP (upstream default 100). Upstream hardcodes this; this image reads it at startup. Behind a reverse proxy every client shares one IP, so the per-IP cap bites sooner than 100/user suggests — raise this if legitimate clients hit 429s. Leave blank for the upstream default.

Config.Name: Sync Global Rate Limit (max)
Config.Description: Max requests per source IP across ALL routes per 15 minutes (upstream default 500). Upstream hardcodes this; this image reads it at startup. Raise alongside the upload limit when many users share one IP via a reverse proxy. Leave blank for the upstream default.

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: SMTP server hostname, required for email verification.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: SMTP port (587 for TLS/STARTTLS, 465 for SSL).

Config.Name: SMTP Secure
Config.Description: true for SSL on port 465, false for STARTTLS on 587.

Config.Name: SMTP User
Config.Description: SMTP authentication username.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: SMTP authentication password.

Config.Name: SMTP From
Config.Description: From address for outgoing emails, e.g. "Super Productivity Sync" <noreply@your-domain.com>
